sources.entry: SaneSales - Universal indie sales tracker for LemonSqueezy, Gumroad, and Stripe with on-device privacy.

summary.one_liner: SaneSales is a free, MIT-licensed native Apple-platform app that pulls sales data from Lemon Squeezy, Gumroad, and Stripe into one private dashboard with charts, widgets, a menu bar revenue total, and CSV export.
summary.what_it_does: The app connects to Lemon Squeezy, Gumroad, and Stripe using the user's own API keys and fetches revenue, orders, and products directly from each provider's API. It shows today, 7-day, 30-day, custom-range, and all-time revenue with trend indicators, plus daily revenue charts built with Swift Charts and a donut chart of revenue by product. Net revenue is calculated after refunds, and orders can be searched and filtered by provider, status, or date. Users can export full order history to CSV, and see revenue on Home Screen, Lock Screen, Apple Watch, and the macOS menu bar. API keys are kept in iCloud Keychain, and sales data is cached on-device for offline access.
use_cases: track revenue across Lemon Squeezy, Gumroad, and Stripe
check daily sales without opening three dashboards
export orders to CSV for accounting
view indie software sales on Mac or iPhone
see revenue in the macOS menu bar
monitor sales from an Apple Watch or Home Screen widget
notable: Connects directly to provider APIs with no intermediary server; sales data stays on the user's devices
Native iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and watchOS apps with widgets and menu bar revenue
Swift 6 strict concurrency with a SalesProvider protocol for platform adapters
Free and open source with every feature unlocked; donations are optional
caveats: Requires iOS 17+ or macOS 14+ and supports Apple Silicon (arm64) only
Build from source requires Xcode 16+ and XcodeGen
Anonymous app counts (trial/license state, locked-feature views) may be sent to SaneApps servers
